data: Which of the following were used in the evaluation of Robust VGG-LSTM ASR?

The question asks which of the following were used in the evaluation of Robust VGG-LSTM ASR. From the caption, we can see two graphs labeled (a) Speaker Verification and (b) Human Test. These graphs show the performance of ThinResNet and d-vector models across different layers. Therefore, the models used in the evaluation were ThinResNet and d-vector.
